sheets.title: DETAILS — ONE LINE DIAGRAM
sheets.reading_notes: Single-sheet electrical one-line diagram for Riverport Welding, Newport News, VA. Project No. 24-053. Depicts service entrance from existing 3.4/6kV, 3-phase 4-wire private overhead utility through (3) 167kVA pole-mounted transformers (3463/6000-120/240V, 2.8% IMP) with (3) 100A cut-outs (fused 20A) and (3) 6kV arresters, to a 1200A NEMA 3R main service breaker (exterior-mounted; main breaker to 1000A, 100K AIC rated) at the building. Distribution via wire trough to: (2) 200A enclosed CBs (120/208V, 3ø, 4W, NEMA 1) and (2) 600A enclosed CBs (120/208V, 3ø, 4W, NEMA 1). Four 600A MLO 120/208V panels (30 circuits each), two labeled E and F (new), two existing (Panels 1 and 2). New Panels E and F each have 15 two-pole 60A breakers serving welding machines; feeder per machine is 3 #4 & 1 #8 GND in 1-1/2 inch conduit. Existing panels also serve welding machines with similar configuration. PE stamp: Richard W. Williams, VA PE #0998004. Title block firm: Bowman Foster & Associates, Inc., Norfolk/Alexandria VA. CAD drawn, checked MLO, Project Engineer MED. Contract no. field is placeholder (XXX-XXXXXXXXXX). Sheet 1 of 1.
